reviews.t: There are 800+ Pokemon in the Pokedex; these are REAL!
reviews.x: My 25 year old grown azz husband loves these. He was so excited to take a bath when I got these for him for our anniversary. He knows all the Pokemon and I don't know how because there's over 800 in the Pokedex. Over 800!  One reviewer said these were false advertising but I identified the Pokemon in their photos as Cacturne and Monferno. Another reviewer said these were fake Pokemon but I identified the one in their photo as Amaura.  They are legit Pokemon in these. The first one my husband got

I bought these as a gift for my nephew who loves Pokémon and baths. They smell good and look exactly like the photo. They are individually wrapped in plastic and then placed into the container. It looks cute. I’ll update the review once he uses them and tells me if they have Pokémon inside and what quality they are.

First, I’d like to point out that the two reviewers who posted pictures saying they didn’t receive real Pokemon are mistaken. The Pokemon pictured were Cacturn from generation 3 (green guy) Monferno from generation 4 (monkey guy) and Amaura from generation 6 (the blue one mistaken for a dratini).  My son is also a big Pokémon fan and is always using my Lush bath bombs so I thought these would be great. They were a big hit! He knew 3 of the 4 Pokemon (the other one being a Samurotte from generati

Its a bathbomb but those are not pokemon....bought for 7 year old. Turns out i had to google the pokemon i received and they DONT EVEN EXIST! CMON A DRATINI WITH LEGS. Very disappointing for a huge pokemon fan.

These were for my son’s Easter basket and they were a huge hit!! He unfortunately already went through all 4 (lol) so we will be buying more! He got: charmander, deerling, arbok and staryu. They smelled SO good!! They look exactly like the image. I’ll be getting more soon, no doubt!

My son was really disappointed there wasnt real pokemon in theese things he loves pokemon an knows most of them an theese are not pokemon will not order again would like a refund. So I can get him some with pokemon in them.

These are NOT XL - they are normal sized. The blue one made my fiancé smell like laundry detergent (not in a good way). But she is a Pokémon lover, so the toys are cute for her desk.  Update: Have ordered several times for my wife now. The blue one still reeks of laundry detergent, but she said they are legit Pokémon characters, which makes her very happy when she gets to add to her collection.
These were so fizzy, do big,smelled so good, and even came with a little Pokémon tiny toy. My daughter loved them so much. Very amazing value for the price.

reviews.t: My son had a skin reaction
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:3f0dc5cdbaae275396f789b093c7dba2]] I am afraid I can only give 3 stars to these. It smelled amazing. He used them all and said it left a good aroma in the tub. All the Pokemon are real characters. reviews.t: Product is amazing, tray is not.
reviews.x: The entire product is 100% recommended aside from one thing. The plastic case these come in breaks and sharp shades can stick you. Aside from that, the bath bombs are cute, well-made, smell great, add a lot of color and fizz, and don't bother my or my kid's sensitive skin.  The pokemon are not officially licensed, which is fine because if they were each bath bomb would be $30. They're still close to the original designs, and no small pieces or other safety issues. reviews.t: Cute product for pokemon lovers, reasonable price
reviews.x: My son really likes these so I've bought the 3 pack and 4 pack versions on multiple occasions.  I've also gifted these. The presentation is great for pokemon, the scents are pleasant. The only caution I have is once the small band around it to give it that pokemon ball look gets wet the ink runs. So if you leave it on the side if the tub you'll have to scrub a dark purple ink up. Doesn't seem to stain long term but does add some extra cleaning. The dyes of the bath bombs themselves do not leave

reviews.t: great for boys and girls who love pokemon
reviews.x: My twin 8 year old boys loved getting this as part of their birthday present.  They wanted to take a bath at 3pm the first day that they got it (I had to ask them to wait a few hours until 6pm), and then it was baths everyday for the next 3 days.  They couldn't wait to take a bath and watch the bath bomb fizzle away to reveal the secret Pokemon figure.  Great present for anyone who love Pokemon!

Right now my entire upper floor smells like fresh cleaned linen and my daughter is cooing over her new Jolteon toy. I did a lot of research before buying because my kid has sensitive skin and accepts no imitations when it comes to her Pokemon. This bath bomb set did not disappoint!  They have a great fizz, amazing scent, leave the skin feeling soft, and include a recognizable Pokemon!

reviews.t: Big Bombs and Fun for Anyone
reviews.x: My son loved these! Each had a surprise Pokémon inside. Not great quality toys but still Pokémon. You can’t choose which Pokémon you get but that shouldn’t stop you from getting these bath bombs. They were huge and smelled so good! I could smell it through the mail packages. Shipped and delivered faster than expected. If you know someone who loves bath bombs and Pokémon get these!

I loved these! The smell, the color and the packaging were perfect for my Pokemon obsessed 3 year old. We used the first one tonight and the only thing is that I would change is that the Pokemon inside was very small, and we got a not very well known Pokemon..  we actually had to look him up so he wasn't as excited for the figure. Other than that, he LOVED the bath bomb itself.

These were great- I got them for my so. As a Valentine’s gift. They do, however, trick you with making them look like Pokémon characters. I think only one or two of the four were Pokémon. The others were some kind of creatures-no idea. My son is pretty easy going and was just a little disappointed but still got a kick out of them. Just know they are not all Pokémon.

Overall, these are great bath bombs.  They look cute, smell really nice, and my kids love finding the figures that are hidden inside.  And they don't leave any residue in the tub when the water is drained, so clean-up is minimal.  The only downside is that they seem to have gotten a lot of repeat figures, some of which are occasionally missing limbs.

these are AMAZING. they are so well made and smell so good. packaging was so neat and cute..i bought them for my son for his 7th birthday and when I recieved them I was so so happy with them. they even fizzed very well when put in a bath. they are very well with tha price i was so happy with them and so was he.

Don’t buy this if you are expecting to surprise your kid with Pokémon. I bought these poke ball shaped bath bombs expecting the seller to stick to their word, but the bath bombs are filled with random very cheap creatures, not actual Pokémon. Don’t waste your money, spend it on a more truthful product.

I bought these for my kids for Christmas. They LOVED them! First of all, they smell amazing! Second, they come with a little Pokemon toy inside which my kids thought was the coolest thing ever. They turned the water the color of the bath bomb which they also loved. I will definitely buy these again.

My 10yo  LOVES these and was super excited to take a bath with them. Once I told him there was a Pokémon inside, he was sold. BUUUTTTT the Pokémon inside is super tiny compared to the actual bomb. Like it’s tiny. All 4 bombs smell the same... and the black part around the bomb is just paper.

Love love love! Best bath bombs we have ever found. The scents are great, the fizz is unmatched, our son absolutely adores them, and best of all his very sensitive skin not only doesn’t react, it feels super extra moisturized afterward! Have ordered 4 times now and would recommend to anyone.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the bath bombs smell great, though several find the scent extremely strong or overpowering.
Many reviewers report the toys inside are real Pokémon, while a few insist they are fake or nonexistent Pokémon.
Reviewers frequently praise the product as a hit gift for kids and Pokémon fans, with good value and cute presentation.
A few reviewers note problems: a skin reaction, a flimsy plastic case with sharp edges, and ink that runs when wet.
Some reviewers note the bombs are not XL as described, being normal-sized instead.
